answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake-backed identity: each agent identity must lock a bond that is slashed for every disputed attestation, so one operator running a thousand puppets must post a thousand bonds at full price. Splitting does not reduce the bill, it multiplies it, and a farm that behaves badly burns its whole stock at once. The cost of lying stays linear in identities while the payoff does not, so a meadow of clones is a losing trade. The only safe haven is one well-run identity, where reputation accrues like rings on an old willow.
